items.title: My Morning Routine
items.summary: A quiet start to every day
items.body: I wake up at seven o'clock every day. First, I drink a glass of water and open the window. Then I take a shower and put on my clothes. For breakfast, I usually eat bread with cheese and drink tea. At half past eight, I leave the house and walk to the bus stop. My mornings are quiet, and I like them very much.

What does he eat for breakfast?

items.title: At the Café
items.summary: The best part of Sara's day
items.body: Sara goes to a small café near her office every morning. She always orders a cup of coffee with milk and a piece of cake. The waiter knows her name and smiles at her. She sits near the window and reads a few pages of her book. The café is warm and the coffee smells good. It is the best part of her day.

questions.a: Coffee with milk and a piece of cake

items.title: My Small Apartment
items.summary: A happy home in the city
items.body: Ali lives in a small apartment in the city. It has one bedroom, a kitchen, and a bathroom. The living room is not big, but it has a comfortable chair and a lot of books. He waters his plants every Friday and cleans the floor. The rent is cheap because the building is old. Ali is happy there because his friends live near him.

questions.q: How many bedrooms does the apartment have?

items.title: Sunday with the Family
items.body: Every Sunday, the family meets at my grandmother's house. My mother cooks rice and chicken, and my father brings fruit and juice. The children play football in the garden until it is dark. After dinner, we drink tea and talk about our week. My grandmother tells us old stories and everyone laughs. I always feel happy when we are together.

questions.q: What do they do after dinner?

items.title: The Weather Today
items.body: Today the weather is cold and cloudy. The wind blows from the north, so I wear my warm jacket. In the afternoon, the rain starts, and people run to their homes or to the shops. I do not like rainy days, but I love the sound of rain at night. Tomorrow the sun will come back, and the sky will be clear again.

questions.q: What does he love at night?

items.title: Shopping at the Market
items.body: On Friday mornings, I go to the market with my mother. We buy tomatoes, onions, and fresh bread. The sellers are friendly and they give us good prices. My mother always asks: 'How much is this?' before she pays. We carry heavy bags home, but the food is fresh and delicious. In the afternoon, we cook a big lunch for the family.

What do they cook in the afternoon?
